title: InfogramVideoPlan
description: Data-driven video plan for single-image camera motion videos. AI generates this JSON from an image + script/voiceover.

image.description: Path to the image file relative to the Remotion public/ directory

fps.description: Frame rate. 60 or 90 recommended for smooth panning

durationSeconds.description: Total video duration in seconds, must match the script/voiceover length

whipPanThreshold.description: Velocity threshold (px/frame) above which whip-pan blur activates

whipPanBlurMax.description: Maximum blur in pixels during whip-pan

time.description: Time in seconds from video start

cx.description: Camera center X on image, normalized 0-1 (0=left, 1=right)

cy.description: Camera center Y on image, normalized 0-1 (0=top, 1=bottom)

scale.description: Zoom level. 1.0=fit whole image, 2.5=close-up on a region

label.description: Optional label for this keyframe, used for debugging
